Goal: Initial Prompt from Epic Creation

It is still not automated

PRD 871 is already queued (pending, behind the currently-running Test Refactor job) — I rewrote its Goal/AC in place to target the real fix (a visible queued/running indicator on the Epics list) instead of the original, now-disproven hypothesis about tag-specific automation. No code changes needed beyond that — the send path itself is correct and doesn't need touching.
the chat queue doesn't seem to add to it or will add it later all at once?

**Summary:** Confirmed the chat queue mechanism itself is correct — messages sent while a run is busy are queued immediately and dispatched strictly one-at-a-time in FIFO order (`chat.ts` `send()`/`dequeueNext()`), never batched. The real issue is that this per-tab queue (`chats[tabId].queue`) has no UI representation anywhere — only an unrelated field (`chatRunner`'s lane `queuedPosition`) is shown. I've added a concrete AC to the already-pending PRD 871 for rendering `chat.queue` in `EpicDetail.tsx` so queued follow-ups are visible instead of silent.
